title: Several library matches ask you to choose, existing parts keep their entry
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit". Two library entries share one part number (production part numbers are not unique).
custom_steps:
1. Create a part whose typed number matches more than one library entry; observe the chooser and pick one.
  2. Open a part created before this feature and confirm it still works with its existing library entry.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If more than one entry matches, the system lists the matching entries and the user chooses one.
  • Parts created before this feature keep working with the part library entry they already have.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 7 (Create a part without a library item); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.
